PowerShell($p='src\\ui\\screens\\CreatureDetail\\FlairRaritySection.js'; $b=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($p\); "len $\($b.Length\)"; "first bytes: " + \(\($b[0..7] | % { $_.ToString\('X2'\) }\) -join ' '\); $nul=@\(\); for\($i=0;$i -lt $b.Length;$i++\){ if\($b[$i] -eq 0\){ $nul+=$i } }; "NUL count: $\($nul.Count\)"; if\($nul.Count\){ "first NUL at $\($nul[0]\); context: " + [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString\($b[[Math]::Max\(0,$nul[0]-60\)..[Math]::Min\($b.Length-1,$nul[0]+20\)]\).Replace\([char]0,'<NUL>'\) }; git diff --stat -- $p; git log -1 --format="%h %s" -- $p)

PowerShell($p='src/ui/screens/CreatureDetail/FlairRaritySection.js'; $tmp="$env:TEMP\\flair_head.js"; cmd /c "git show HEAD:$p > `"$tmp`""; $h=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($tmp\); $w=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($p\); "HEAD len $\($h.Length\) CR $\(\($h|?{$_ -eq 13}\).Count\) LF $\(\($h|?{$_ -eq 10}\).Count\) NUL $\(\($h|?{$_ -eq 0}\).Count\)"; "WORK len $\($w.Length\) CR $\(\($w|?{$_ -eq 13}\).Count\) LF $\(\($w|?{$_ -eq 10}\).Count\) NUL $\(\($w|?{$_ -eq 0}\).Count\)"; "HEAD first 3 line ends: " + \(\($h[38..45] | % { $_.ToString\('X2'\) }\) -join ' '\))
